item.title: Cartoon of the Week: The Burn Ban Exception
item.description: A burn ban may stop brush fires, but it doesn’t slow fear, outrage, or misinformation. Some fires don’t require permits.

item.title: BOM promotions
item.description: BOM Financial Services is thrilled to announce the promotion of Reba Phelps to BOMFS Director. Reba has been with BOMFS for 19 years and this promotion is a direct reflection of her leadership and dedication to BOMFS’ success. We can’t wait to see the lasting impact she will have in the coming years.

item.description: Natchitoches Parish residents can expect a mix of mild temperatures, increasing rain chances, and a noticeable cool-down as the week progresses, according to the latest forecast.
